name: RentLens NSW
question: What are tenants actually paying across NSW?
summary: Turns official NSW rental bond lodgements into median weekly rents by dwelling type, postcode and month: signed rents, not asking prices. A tested dbt pipeline on DuckDB feeds a live dashboard.

details.statusNote: Live. The dashboard and the pipeline behind it are both published.
overview: Listing sites show what landlords are asking. NSW Fair Trading records what tenants actually signed, through rental bond lodgements.
RentLens turns those official records into median weekly rents by dwelling type, postcode and month, and flags bad rows such as missing or implausible rents before they reach the numbers.

architecture.summary: Monthly spreadsheets are downloaded and landed as Parquet, modelled with dbt on DuckDB, and published as a static Chart.js dashboard.
steps: Ingest: download and land as Parquet (safe to re-run)
dbt marts: median rents by month and by postcode

decisions.title: Watermark on arrival time, not lodgement date
decisions.body: An incremental model needs a watermark. Using the event time (lodgement date) would silently drop late-arriving records, so the model keys on when each file arrived. A test checks that late records land; it only proves the incremental case once a second, later batch of files is added, which is still to do.
decisions.chose: Watermark on the arrival time of each file
decisions.rejected: Watermark on the lodgement date (event time)
decisions.why: Event time would silently drop late-arriving records. A test checks that late records land; it only proves the incremental case once a second, later batch of files is added, which is still to do.

practices: dbt build (models plus tests) runs in CI on every push and pull request.
A script checks the numbers published on the dashboard against the pipeline's output.
An engineering log and an architecture decision record document the work.
The dashboard's third-party script is pinned with Subresource Integrity.
Dashboard accessibility, performance and security measurements are recorded with dates and commands in this site's METRICS.md.

data.source: NSW Fair Trading rental bond lodgements
data.note: Median rents are my own aggregation of that data and are not an official NSW Government statistic.

roadmap: Will add a data.json pipeline: Python queries the dbt marts and the dashboard reads the result dynamically.
Will add dbt column descriptions and publish dbt docs to GitHub Pages.
Will add a SQL agent over the DuckDB marts.
Will ingest each month automatically when NSW publishes new data.
limitations: Covers new tenancies only: it shows the rent agreed at lease signing, not what existing tenants pay now.
Bonds can be lodged up to about six weeks after a lease starts, so the latest months fill in late.

headings.how: A re-runnable ingest and three dbt layers turn bond records into median rents
headings.decisions: Keying on arrival time stops late bond records being dropped
headings.verify: dbt tests run in CI on every push, and the dashboard is checked against the pipeline
headings.next: Next, the dashboard will read straight from the pipeline
